decisions.reason: As a flagship multi-model electric infrared line that directly supports the firm's lower-carbon direction and broader building-climate offering, it remains strategically important.

The electric halogen infrared heater still usefully complements the portfolio for specific spot-heating applications, but it remains more exposed to overlap and prioritization pressure than the core flagship lines.
This industrial electric infrared hall heater line stays close to the firm's core business in large non-residential spaces and fits customer demand for efficient hall heating.
The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater remains a strategic direction product with reference use in practice and strong alignment with the firm's push toward lower-carbon heating solutions.
